awarded_by: Society for the Conferring of the International Charlemagne Prize, Aachen
detail: Awarded on 13 May 2010 in Aachen, with a laudation by Chancellor Angela Merkel. The board honoured him as a 'Polish patriot and great European' who, with the Solidarity movement, helped lay the foundations for the reunification of Europe and who stands for a democratic, open Poland within Europe.

awarded_by: Walther Rathenau Institut / Walther Rathenau Stiftung, Berlin
detail: The 2011 prize was presented to him on 31 May 2012 in Berlin, with a laudation by Angela Merkel, in recognition of his commitment to European integration during Poland's EU Council presidency in the second half of 2011 and for fostering Polish–German dialogue.

honor: Order of the Cross of Terra Mariana, 1st Class
detail: Estonian state decoration listed among his foreign honours.

honor: Order of Prince Yaroslav the Wise, 1st Class
detail: Conferred in May 2019, near the end of his term as President of the European Council.

honor: Grand Cordon of the Order of the Rising Sun
detail: Announced in Japan's spring 2021 list of decorations for foreign nationals (29 April 2021) for strengthening Japan–EU ties, including the Economic Partnership Agreement and Strategic Partnership Agreement concluded during his European Council presidency; the conferment ceremony took place on 19 October 2022.

awarded_by: Chatham House (Royal Institute of International Affairs), London
detail: Announced on 20 June 2024 for his 'commitment to restoring democracy in Poland, rebuilding institutions, and rehabilitating and upholding the principles of the rule of law'. Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski accepted it on his behalf in London on 17 July 2024; PiS politicians criticised the award, arguing that his government was itself accused of breaching the rule of law.
